Abuse.positive: One person repeatedly strikes or forcefully handles another person in a sustained one-sided interaction.
Abuse.negative: People are sitting or walking together in a calm social interaction.

Arrest.positive: Police officers hold a person's arms and place handcuffs on them.
Arrest.negative: People are standing and talking together in a public area.

Arson.positive: A person holds a flame or ignition source against a building, vehicle, or object.
Arson.negative: A person walks or stands beside a building, vehicle, or object during an ordinary activity.

Assault.positive: One person hits, kicks, or punches another person during a short physical attack.
Assault.negative: Two people are talking or walking together in a social interaction.

Burglary.positive: A person enters a building and searches drawers, rooms, or indoor belongings.
Burglary.negative: A person enters a building and walks through rooms during an ordinary indoor activity.

Explosion.positive: A sudden blast rapidly throws debris outward and produces a visible shock or burst.
Explosion.negative: People and vehicles move normally through an outdoor scene.

Fighting.positive: Two or more people exchange pushes, punches, or kicks in a mutual physical struggle.
Fighting.negative: Two or more people walk or talk together in a social interaction.

RoadAccidents.positive: A vehicle collides with another vehicle or obstacle, crashes, or overturns on a road.
RoadAccidents.negative: Vehicles drive normally along a road while maintaining their lanes.

Robbery.positive: A person visibly uses force against another person while taking an item or money at a business or public place.
Robbery.negative: A customer hands money to a cashier and receives an item at a checkout counter.

Shooting.positive: A person aims or fires a gun toward another person, vehicle, or object.
Shooting.negative: A person walks or stands in a public area while carrying out an ordinary activity.

Shoplifting.positive: A customer conceals store merchandise and carries it past shelves or a checkout area.
Shoplifting.negative: A customer selects store merchandise and places it in a shopping basket.

Stealing.positive: A person removes an item from another person's bag, vehicle, or immediate possession.
Stealing.negative: A person carries or hands an item to another person during an ordinary exchange.

Vandalism.positive: A person strikes, breaks, sprays, or otherwise damages a wall, vehicle, or other object.
Vandalism.negative: A person cleans, repairs, or uses a wall, vehicle, or other object normally.

B1.positive: People exchange pushes, punches, or kicks in a mutual physical struggle.
B1.negative: People walk or talk together in a social interaction.

B2.positive: A person aims or fires a gun toward another person, vehicle, or object.
B2.negative: A person walks or stands in a public area during an ordinary activity.

B4.positive: A crowd throws objects, pushes through barriers, or clashes in a violent public disturbance.
B4.negative: A crowd gathers and moves together in an organized public activity.

B5.positive: One person repeatedly strikes or forcefully handles another person in a sustained one-sided interaction.
B5.negative: People sit or walk together in a calm social interaction.

B6.positive: A vehicle collides with another vehicle or obstacle, crashes, or overturns on a road.
B6.negative: Vehicles drive normally along a road while maintaining their lanes.

G.positive: A sudden blast rapidly throws debris outward and produces a visible shock or burst.
G.negative: People and vehicles move normally through an outdoor scene.
